paragraphs: Rav Adda bar Abba spoke to Rava, Pesachim 69b; before Rava, Menachot 5b and Bava Batra 133a. See above, Rav Adda bar Ahavah, what I wrote from Tosafot, Bava Batra 22a. Chapter Tolin: Rav Adda bar Abba said, “They say in Rav’s academy,” contrary to Rav Nachman (see there, 141a). Ketubbot 68b: Ravina told Rava, “Rav Adda bar Abba told us in your name.”
